name: Gayness
overview: Scripture addresses the topic of gayness with clear moral directives, affirming that sexual relations between men are considered an abomination, as stated in Leviticus 18:22 and 20:13. The narrative of Sodom in Genesis 19 illustrates the severity of such actions in the eyes of God. While Isaiah 56:3 acknowledges those who may be different, including eunuchs, it emphasizes their inclusion in the Lord’s people when they join Him. Jesus reaffirms the created order of male and female in Matthew 19:4, and calls believers to withhold judgment of others in Matthew 7:1, reminding us to approach this topic with humility and grace.
